items.name: Delta lager - 4% | 21 IBU
items.description: Born from the waters of the Delta, this lager is brewed with a deep golden colour. It has a soft, smooth maltiness with notes of biscuit and nuts that compliment subtle hop aromas. This lager captures the essence of the untamed wilderness, where each sip transports you to the heart of the Okavango.

items.name: Kingfisher session IPA - 4.5% | 32 IBU
items.description: Hop forward yet refreshing, bursting with tropical fruit brightness that leads to a crisp and clean bitter finish. Perfect for a sunny afternoon, this beer embodies the spirit of adventure.

items.name: Delta lager - 4% | 21 IBU
items.description: This pale ale is named after the primary millet growing region in the Panhandle area of the Okavango. It reflects a true balance between malty, caramel notes and a mildly bitter spice aroma. This beer transports you to the Panhandle, where the millet fields sway under the warm African sun.

items.name: Simonsvlei Treasure of SA Sauv Blanc
items.description: Inviting aromas of green pepper, grapefruit and granadilla with touches of green fig. On the palate, it is juicy and concentrated with layers of fruit and a fresh acidity on the finish.

items.name: Painted Wolf Sauv Blanc
items.description: Bursting with aromas of tropical fruits pineapple, peaches, and hints of lemon.

items.name: Douglas Green Vineyard Friends Sauv Blanc
items.description: Expressive varietal character with a complex nose of passionfruit and gooseberry, hints of flintiness and white stone fruit. The palate is mouthwatering with ripe fruit acidity, supported by a good structure.

items.name: KWV Chenin Blanc
items.description: On the nose it displays prominent aromas of apple, guava and passion fruit. The palate is well-rounded and juicy with hints of vibrant, fresh pear.

items.name: Fat Bastard Chenin Blanc
items.description: Juicy yellow peach and a hint of vanilla fill the palate with flavour, lingering with a tangy note of fresh lime on the finish.

items.name: Simonsvlei Treasure of SA Chenin Blanc
items.description: The wine has a distinctive yellow apple, kiwi fruit and pineapple core, alongside notes of green melon and limes. The wine is thus bursting with fresh fruit flavours. The wine has a zesty citrus flavour linger on the palate, with a long mineral finish.

items.name: Simonsvlei Vineyard Selection Chardonnay
items.description: Lightly wooded Chardonnay offers a rich and lush texture, with a wide array of flavors that can range from citrus and stone fruits to tropical fruits. The oak aging process adds a creamy and buttery richness, as well as notes of toast and vanilla. This rich and full bodied wine, notes of citrus and flavours of vanilla and butter.

items.name: Fat Bastard Chardonnay
items.description: Classic ripe, rich butter and tropical fruit on the nose with soft, well-integrated vanilla on the palate.

items.name: Van Loveren Perle De Jean Pinot Grigio
items.description: Fresh notes of raspberries, strawberries, red currant, ripe citrus and melon with a gentle lemon undertone.

items.name: Simonsvlei Treasure of SA Pinotage Rose
items.description: It’s an off-dry rose with pomegranate, cranberry with nuances of candy floss and floral notes add to the complexity of this wine. Delicate flavours of red berry fruit linger on the palate and add to the freshness of the wine.

items.name: Porcupine Ridge Merlot
items.description: A classic nose shows red plums, cranberry, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg at play with intriguing whiffs of rosemary, thyme & oregano

items.name: Simonsvlei Vineyard Selection Merlot
items.description: This Merlot is a dry red wine with intense flavour and colour, full of ripe fruit with dark chocolate and almond undertones. This wine is aged in stainless steel tanks with stave wood maturation.

items.name: Leopards Leap Pinotage
items.description: Fruity aromas of raspberries and red currant are supported by subtle nuances of vanilla and barbecue spice.

items.name: KWV Pinotage
items.description: This rich and flavourful Pinotage shows upfront fruit sweetness with plum, banana and fruitcake aromas.

items.name: Simonsvlei Treasure of SA Shiraz
items.description: Shiraz wine is a red wine made from a grape variety that is called Syrah in Europe and Shiraz in Australia and other regions. It has a peppery and fruity flavor, with blackberry, blueberry, plum, and cherry being common fruit notes. It also has tannins and may have other flavors like tobacco, licorice, chocolate, vanilla, coffee, and mocha.

items.name: Simonsvlei Treasure of SA Cab Sauv
items.description: Cabernet Sauvignon is a full-bodied red wine with high acidity and tannin, and black fruit notes of black cherry, blackberry, cassis, and plum. It also has vegetal notes of green pepper, herbaceous notes of mint and tobacco, and spice notes of vanilla, cedar, and black pepper from oak aging.

items.name: Painted Wolf Cab Sauv
items.description: An easy-drinking style of Cabernet Sauvignon with classic flavours of blackcurrant and cigar box with some subtle yet toasty oak.

items.name: Simonsvlei Toffee Chunks
items.description: Full bodied, dry Syrah with a notable toffee smell and taste.

items.name: Simonsvlei Ja Mocha
items.description: Full bodied Pinotage with a very strong mocha(coffee) flavour and smell. These flavours come from using an overdose of a mix between French and American oak while making this lovely wine.

items.name: Fat Bastard Golden Reserve
items.description: The wine has intense, dark ruby colour. Luxurious aromas and flavours of dark berry fruit and plum entice the senses. The palate of the wine is rich and full with silky and lasting finish.

items.name: Rupert & Rothschild
items.description: Gives off rich aromas of dark fruit like blackcurrants and cherries, as well as a hint of tobacco and chocolate.

items.name: Es La Vida Rose
items.description: Crafted from red Muscadel grapes, offering a semi-sweet, fruity profile with a refreshing crispness and a gentle sparkle that gives it a delightful, effortlessly drinkable charm.

items.name: Robertson Sparkling Brut
items.description: It displays appealing flavours of apple and pear with subtle floral aromas.
